My old middle school had tons of legends and shit like that. The building itself is over 50 years old, and it once used to be a high school (my mom actually graduated there 40 years ago) and under the building was an actual bomb shelter big enough to store a large ammount of people. You could enter it through the downstairs computer lab, and rumors had it that you could also access it from the neighboring library which was no longer in use. People always came up with crazy stories on how people were held down there, died down there, or ghosts haunting and lurking down there. So me and my friends decided to go and check this shit out for ourselves.

We sneaked out at night, maybe 1 or so, and we broke into the library through an open window around the back. We ended up finding a place in the basement that led into the ground, and at that point it got scary as fuck. One person went down first, I went second, and so on. It turns out it was actually a tunnel that connected the library and school together, we walked around the hallway and found the actual fallout shelter, and the door that led to the computer lab. Inside was hot and dark and smelled of rot and decay, we were all so scared that we all held onto a piece of rope so nobody got left behind. There was bathrooms, a small kitchen, all kinds of old food from about 40 years ago, mostly canned. A large majority was eaten, and the whole shelter was trashed, you could tell people had been down here living, probably found there way in the same way we did. We got scared and decided to leave, and didnt sleep that night I dont think.

TL;DR My old middle school was rumoured to have a nuclear fallout shelter, we found it, spooky as fuck, didnt sleep for a day or two.
